senses.def: perhaps; indicating possibility of being more remarkable (greater or better or sooner) than
Indicates that a statement is true in the event that a condition is not satisfied.
ex: The plant will die if not watered.

senses.def: Indicates that one statement at least is true, and possibly a second, stronger statement is true; perhaps even.
ex: He did as well as expected, if not better.

senses.def: Indicates that one statement is true, but a second is not; but not.
ex: I saw that he had improved his manners if not his scruffy appearance.

senses.def: If (something) were not (or had not been) there; in the absence of (something); without.
ex: If not for her surgical skill, you'd be dead now, so some appreciation may be in order.

senses.def: At the very least; as a minimum.
